blocks.text: READ: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo coach Louie Alas was quick to let his Blue Eagles off the hook after their 94-75 loss to the University of the Philippines in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Saturday. Alas said there would be no blame game in the Ateneo locker room after the team’s first loss of the season, and if anyone had to take responsibility, he was willing to shoulder it. “I told them after the huddle that I won’t blame them because this kind of loss can easily […]...
